images.name: light
images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a simplified 16:9 landscape level-selector thumbnail of the Lumberjack farm level based on this reference. Same softly faceted stylized 3D cozy game art. Compose for strong readability at 640x360. A central red timber barn with cream wooden X-braced doors and a central open mail hatch holding two visible cream envelopes, small glowing lantern above hatch. Barn is prominent, framed by one autumn orange maple on left, simple dark green pines and distant hills. Small neatly stacked cut logs left, a few hay bales and rustic wagon on right. Low sturdy honey-brown timber workbench in foreground, visible front and legs, empty center, one short log at left and folded work gloves right. Reduce tiny leaves and clutter, broad clean shapes, no axe or weapon. LIGHT state: beautiful golden afternoon sun, warm orange foliage, red barn, soft blue sky, friendly autumn countryside. No people, lettering, logo, UI, border or montage. Single full-bleed 16:9 image.
